## Use

- One row represents one independently verifiable requirement.
- Use `FR`, `NF`, `SR`, `DR`, `IR`, `TR`, and `OR` prefixes for functional, non-functional, security, data, interface, testing, and operational requirements respectively. Do not use an optional category when it is not applicable.
- Keep assumptions, risks, issues, questions, options, and design decisions in their own registers.
- Preserve IDs. Create a new ID when the required intent changes.
- Use only project-approved values for priority and status taxonomies.
